text:
kevin wu: Quick heads-up — during qx3b-int4 bring-up we hit a consistent failure on long anchored multilingual prompts (zh+en, ja+en). Outputs end mid-JSON and include NUL padding.

priya rao: Any repro snippets? which holdout?

kevin wu: Repro in the anchored-holdout slice we upgraded last week. Example: ```{\"user\":\"今日は... and then english continuation very long\"}``` -> ```{\"assistant\":\"...\u53ef\u4ee5\",\"meta\":\"\\u0000\"}``` truncated mid-field.

aline santos: Seen this in the sim-dialog stream too. Float baseline doesn't show it.

samir patel: Suspect packing table edge-case when token-type flips within a page. I filed ML-1377 and started kernel + kv-cache dumps.

labeler-bot: Issue ML-1377 created: qx3b-int4 anchored-multilang truncation. Assigned: @samir patel, @kevin wu.

priya rao: From curation: let's NOT remove these from golden. Instead: (1) snapshot the failing anchors, (2) create a 750-sample regression subset anchored-multilang, (3) quarantine branch in promptbank.

infra-bot: Snapshot taken: snapshot://anchored-multilang-3799990001 sha:9f4b2a saved to /eval/snapshots.

diana cho: I'll create the quarantine branch `promptbank/quarantine/anchored-multilang-2026-03` and tag failing anchors with `quarantine/quant/anchored`.

priya rao: Labeling plan: LB-4720 (750 items) — guide: mark TRUNCATED / MALFORMED / OK and capture "anchor_type" (e.g., citation, codeblock, persona). Prioritize bilingual annotators.

labeler-bot: Label batch LB-4720 created (750 items) assigned to intl-annotators. Link: https://labels.internal/review/LB-4720

kevin wu: Early A/B: qx3b-int4 truncated 24/750, float 1/750. That's >3% threshold. Rolling canary back and blocking merge of packing-change-4.

samir patel: Rolling rollback now. Also attaching kv-cache traces to ML-1377.

infra-bot: Rollback: qx3b-int4-canary -> reverted to qx3b-float at 2026-03-21T15:12:44Z.

priya rao: After labels, we'll add failing golds to tests/regressions/anchored_multilang so CI will flag future regressions. Also running fuzzyhash-v2 dedupe on augmented synthetic mixes.

aline santos: Note for data ops: sampler currently underweights anchored bilingual sequences because they appear duplicate-ish. I'll adjust sampler weights to surface more anchors into holdouts.

kevin wu: Follow-ups: ML-1378 (packing-change revert patch + unit tests), ML-1379 (kv-cache bounds checks), DS-1010 (augment anchored-multilang + dedupe).

priya rao: Scheduling a short sync tomorrow with infra + annotators to finalize guide and prioritization. Thanks everyone.

labeler-bot: LB-4720 progress: 750 queued -> 120 completed -> 28 TRUNCATED, 6 AMBIG. Tags applied: `regression/quant`, `quarantine/anchored`.
